user.title: Select region
user.description: Choose the EFA region for your area.

custom_url.title: Custom EFA URL
custom_url.description: Enter the base URL of the EFA instance (e.g. `https://www.efa-bw.de/bvb3`).

enter_city.title: Enter city / place
enter_city.description:
Region: **{region}**

Enter the full name of your city or place.
Examples: `Stuttgart`, `Freiburg im Breisgau`, `München`

search_stop.title: Search stop
search_stop.description:
Place: **{city}**

Enter the name of the stop (e.g. `Hauptbahnhof` or `Marktplatz`).

select_stop.title: Select stop
select_stop.description: {count} results found in **{city}**. Please select the desired stop:

select_lines.title: Select lines + direction
select_lines.description:
Select the desired lines **per direction of travel**. A line can appear more than once — once per destination/direction. Choose "All lines" for no filter (old behaviour).

Stop: **{stop_name}**

set_counts.title: Number of departures per selection
set_counts.description:
For each selected line/direction, set how many departure sensors should be created. This guarantees every selection gets its own sensors, regardless of how often other lines depart.

Selection: **{selection}**

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to EFA API.
error.no_results: No stops found. Please try a different search term.
error.invalid_url: Please enter a valid URL (starting with http/https).
error.no_results_check_city: No stops found. Check your search term — or go back and enter the full place name (e.g. 'Freiburg im Breisgau' instead of 'Freiburg').

abort.already_configured: This stop is already configured for this endpoint.

init.title: Options
init.description: Re-select the desired lines per direction, or adjust the existing selection. The number of sensors per selection is set in the next step.

set_counts.title: Number of departures per selection
set_counts.description:
For each selected line/direction, set how many departure sensors should be created.

Selection: **{selection}**
